clue.text: A rhythm with resonant echoes is worst

parts.note: a beat is the pulse or rhythm of music
a hollow sound is one that echoes and resonates

explanation.surface: A drummer's echoing rhythm is judged the worst of the lot.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Worst' is a verb here, to defeat, not the superlative of bad.
explanation.definitionFit: To beat someone hollow is to defeat them utterly, which is what worsting them means.

clue.text: Magistrate with a hooked nose

explanation.surface: A magistrate is described by a distinctive facial feature.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Beak' is British slang for a magistrate or judge.
explanation.definitionFit: British slang calls a magistrate a beak, and a large curved nose is also likened to a bird's bill.

clue.text: Now is a time to exhibit

parts.note: to present something is to show or exhibit it

explanation.surface: This moment is the right time to put something on display.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means currently, at this moment.

clue.text: Greeting everyone in the house

indicators.note: everyone sits inside the house, so one piece goes within the other

parts.note: HO is the abbreviation for house
all means everyone

explanation.surface: Someone calls out a greeting to everybody at home.
explanation.definitionFit: A variant of hello, a word of salutation.

clue.text: Paying attention to a stock quotation

explanation.surface: An investor watches the share prices closely.
explanation.walkthrough: To list is an old verb for listen, so listing is paying attention.
explanation.definitionFit: Archaically to list is to listen; a company's listing is its quoted entry on the stock exchange.

clue.text: The crime of a criminal dealer

parts.note: a fence is someone who deals in stolen goods

explanation.surface: A receiver of stolen goods is charged with his wrongdoing.
explanation.definitionFit: An offence is a breach of the law, a crime.

clue.text: European banker in the centre of Hebron

indicators.note: the letters sit in the middle of the place name, with its ends dropped

explanation.surface: A European financier is based in a Middle Eastern city.
explanation.walkthrough: A 'banker' in crosswords is often a river, since it has banks; the Ebro flows through Spain.
explanation.definitionFit: The Ebro is a river in Spain, and a river is something with banks.

clue.text: Compelled to jump

explanation.surface: Someone is forced to leap.
explanation.definitionFit: Being bound to do something means being obliged; a bound is also a leap.

clue.text: Servicemen conveyed male German in old armoured vehicles

indicators.note: the vehicles carry the German inside them, so one piece is placed within the other

parts.note: tanks are armoured fighting vehicles
Herr is the German title for a man

explanation.surface: Soldiers transported a German man in old tanks.
explanation.definitionFit: In the British forces the term covers soldiers below commissioned rank, enlisted servicemen.

clue.text: Be proud to participate in an open-air vigil

definitions.text: to participate in an open-air vigil

explanation.surface: Someone is proud to take part in an outdoor protest vigil.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Proud' here means projecting, as a surface stands proud; the second reading is standing outside.
explanation.definitionFit: To stand out is to project or be conspicuous; literally it is standing outdoors, as at a vigil.

clue.text: Horrify a quiet friend

parts.note: P is piano, the musical direction for quiet
a pal is a friend

explanation.surface: Someone shocks a softly spoken companion.
explanation.definitionFit: To appal is to fill with dismay or horror.

clue.text: Pat is a person easily imposed upon

explanation.surface: Pat is described as a pushover.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Pat' reads as a name but is a light tap, a soft touch.
explanation.definitionFit: A pat is a gentle tap; a pushover who is easily exploited is also called this.

clue.text: Great love for Spanish uncle in SW county

indicators.note: the uncle is placed inside the county

parts.note: Devon is a county in south-west England
tio is the Spanish word for uncle

explanation.surface: A Spaniard feels deep affection for his uncle living in the West Country.
explanation.walkthrough: DEVON is a county in south-west England.
explanation.definitionFit: Devotion is deep loyalty and ardent affection.

clue.text: The bottom of the drain needs repair

indicators.note: something needing repair is broken, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: The base of a blocked drain must be fixed.
explanation.definitionFit: The nadir is the lowest point.

clue.text: Property confers genuine social standing

parts.note: real means genuine
an estate is an old word for rank or condition in society, as in the three estates

explanation.surface: Owning land brings someone true status.
explanation.definitionFit: Real estate is land and buildings, immovable property.

clue.text: Getting things straight at the end of the day

explanation.surface: Someone tidies everything up at dusk.
explanation.definitionFit: Making things level is evening them; the later part of the day is also this.

clue.text: It's my turn to shout abuse

explanation.surface: Someone offers to buy a round and then hurls insults.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Shout' is British and Australian slang for buying a round of drinks, so 'It's my turn to shout' is I'LL TREAT.
explanation.definitionFit: Split as I'll treat it offers to pay; as one word it means to mistreat or harm.

clue.text: Heather holds part of the Bible to be lewd literature

indicators.note: the heather grips the Bible section inside it

parts.note: erica is the botanical genus of heather
OT is the Old Testament

explanation.surface: A woman called Heather keeps a scripture passage tucked into racy reading.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Heather' looks like a name, but it is the plant, genus Erica.
explanation.definitionFit: Erotica is writing or art intended to arouse sexual desire.

clue.text: Incarnate being composed when under hypnosis

indicators.note: composing something puts its parts in a new order, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A god in human form remains serene while hypnotised.
explanation.definitionFit: A hypnotised subject is said to be entranced, in a dazed state.

clue.text: Allowed petticoat to be given away

parts.note: let means allowed
a slip is a petticoat or underskirt

explanation.surface: A petticoat was permitted to be handed over.
explanation.definitionFit: To let something slip is to reveal it inadvertently, giving a secret away.

clue.text: To steal in sympathy shows moral rectitude

indicators.note: stealing is placed inside the sympathy

parts.note: pity is sympathy
to rob is to steal

explanation.surface: A thief who shows compassion proves himself honest.
explanation.definitionFit: Probity is uprightness and honesty.

clue.text: TUC has to retrench

parts.note: the three letters are the word cut written backwards

explanation.surface: The Trades Union Congress is forced to make economies.
explanation.walkthrough: The TUC is Britain's Trades Union Congress; read the answer as an instruction and it produces those letters.
explanation.definitionFit: To retrench is to reduce spending, to make economies.

clue.text: Two military commanders head for a shy target

indicators.note: two signals that the commanding officer appears twice

parts.note: CO is a commanding officer
nut is slang for head

explanation.surface: Two officers set off towards a timid objective.
explanation.walkthrough: A coconut shy is a British fairground stall where balls are thrown at coconuts; 'shy' is not timid.
explanation.definitionFit: At a fairground shy, players throw balls to knock these hairy fruit off stands.

clue.text: Guide on a cattle ranch

explanation.surface: Someone leads the way at a ranch.
explanation.definitionFit: To guide is to direct a course; a young castrated bull raised for beef is found on a ranch.

clue.text: Heath makes morning departure from the States

indicators.note: the morning leaves the country's name, so those letters are taken out

parts.note: America is the United States

explanation.surface: Edward Heath leaves the United States one morning.
explanation.walkthrough: Heath reads as a politician's name, but it is the plant: erica is the heather genus.
explanation.definitionFit: Erica is the botanical genus of heath plants.

clue.text: A phrase used by Henry V yet again

definitions.text: A phrase used by Henry V

explanation.surface: A famous line from Shakespeare's king is quoted again.
explanation.walkthrough: Shakespeare's Henry V rallies his troops with 'Once more unto the breach'.
explanation.definitionFit: The words open the king's battle speech, and they also mean one further time.

clue.text: Fool Doctor Hubbard

parts.note: MO is a medical officer
L. Ron Hubbard was the founder of Scientology

explanation.surface: A doctor named Hubbard is called an idiot.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Doctor Hubbard' suggests Mother Hubbard or a person; split it.
explanation.definitionFit: A moron is a stupid person, an idiot.

clue.text: Not so much belongs to Leslie

parts.note: Les is the short form of the name Leslie
possession is shown by an apostrophe s, so belonging adds the letter S

explanation.surface: Leslie owns a smaller amount.
explanation.walkthrough: Something that belongs to Leslie is 'Les's'.
explanation.definitionFit: Less is a smaller quantity, fewer, not as much.

clue.text: I am in a state-a lively state

indicators.note: I am is placed inside a state

parts.note: a nation is a state
I'm is the contraction of I am

explanation.surface: Someone says they are excited, in a nervous state.
explanation.definitionFit: Animation is liveliness, a state of vivacity and spirit.

clue.text: Line of hills limiting a gun's effectiveness

explanation.surface: A gun's reach is restricted by surrounding hills.
explanation.definitionFit: A chain of mountains is a range; a gun's range is the distance it can effectively fire.

clue.text: A large landlady full of vivacity

indicators.note: the words are full of the letters, so they are found inside them

explanation.surface: A big landlady is bursting with liveliness.
explanation.definitionFit: Elan is dash, flair and energy.

clue.text: Brandy Tess served out to the spectators

indicators.note: serving out spreads the drink around, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Tess pours brandy for those watching.
explanation.definitionFit: Bystanders are people who watch an event without taking part.
